therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: previously treated ER-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Progression-Free Survival (PFS) by investigator per RECIST v1.1

results.effect_size: HR 0.81 (95% CI: 0.60–1.10); median PFS 5.55 months vs 5.36 months
results.target_engagement_evidence: Plasma giredestrant geometric mean concentrations measured at multiple timepoints (117–268 ng/mL), confirming systemic exposure
biomarker_changes: ESR1 mutation detected at baseline subgroup: HR 0.60 (95% CI: 0.35–1.03), p=0.0610 favoring giredestrant
ESR1 mutation not detected at baseline subgroup: HR 0.88 (95% CI: 0.54–1.42), p=0.5947
subgroup_findings: ESR1 mutation detected at baseline: median PFS 5.32 vs 3.48 months (HR 0.60, 95% CI 0.35–1.03, p=0.0610) favoring giredestrant
ESR1 mutation not detected at baseline: median PFS 7.20 vs 6.60 months (HR 0.88, 95% CI 0.54–1.42, p=0.5947)
safety_signals: Serious cardiac events in giredestrant arm: cardiac failure (2), cardiac failure acute (1), myocardial infarction (2)
Serious GI events in giredestrant arm: diarrhoea (1), vomiting (2)
COVID-19 serious events in physician's choice arm (2)

dose_info.schedule: once daily on Days 1-28 of each 28-day cycle

context.indication: ER-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
context.comparator: physician's choice of endocrine monotherapy (fulvestrant or aromatase inhibitor)
context.duration: median follow-up 7.9 months for PFS; 34.6 months for OS
